mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, activity_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM registration WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND activity_id = #{activityId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, student_id, activity_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM registration WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id, r.student_id, s.name AS student_name, r.activity_id, a.title AS activity_title, a.start_at AS activity_start_at, a.location AS activity_location, a.policy_type, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM registration r JOIN student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id JOIN activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registration (student_id, activity_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{activityId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
